content.storyline: No. 3 Notre Dame improved to 10-1 with a 24-3 win, and its defense held SMU to its lowest point total since 2016. SMU’s 126-game streak of scoring in double digits gave way to back-to-back losses scoring fewer than 10 points.

basis.reasoning: The recap reports Notre Dame’s 24-3 victory over SMU, confirming the game was played to a final result.

excerpts:
3 Notre Dame past SMU 24-3

By AP

Nov 21, 2026, 11:13 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- — Notre Dame’s defense held SMU to its lowest point total since 2016, and the No. 3 Fighting Irish ground out a 24-3 victory Saturday.

It was SMU’s lowest point total since a 33-3 loss to TCU in September 2016.

Notre Dame (10-1) stopped six SMU drives inside Fighting Irish territory. Notre Dame turned the Mustangs (7-4) over three times on downs, at the 19, the 2 and the 3.

After rolling up a streak of 126 consecutive games scoring in double-digits, SMU has now suffered back-to-back losses scoring less than 10 points.

recap.paragraph: The final score read 24-3, with No. 6 Notre Dame on top! Cooper Flanagan ran 2 yards for the first touchdown. CJ Carr then zipped a 21-yard touchdown pass to Jordan Faison. Nolan James Jr. added a 4-yard touchdown run. Notre Dame’s determined defense held SMU to its lowest score since 2016. The win lifted Notre Dame’s record to 10-1.
